_note: Every threshold of the Account Manager's sizing: how many shares to buy. There is no size limit anywhere (design choices entry 91: the only check is that the account's funds cover the order). Read once; a missing or unknown key is an error. No model chooses one. clarify: the limits of the Ask-mode loop that asks the user how much to buy (design choices entry 85): at most max_questions questions, max_problems replies of the model or answers of the user that are refused before it gives up and the default size is shown. direct: a trade the user named themselves (entry 87) has no Critic approval to run out, so its own price check runs out valid_minutes after the Account Manager priced it. neutral: the same for a company the Advisor scored neutral that ALLOW_NEUTRAL_RECOMMENDATIONS lets through (entry 91): it has no Critic approval either.
